🎥🎬: VisionQuest (2026)

Following the events of WandaVision, White Vision is left struggling with questions about his identity, memories, and what it truly means to be human. Although he possesses the memories of the original Vision, he lacks the emotional connections that once defined him. Now free from his previous mission, he begins searching for answers about his existence and the life he was supposed to have.

As powerful forces and familiar faces from the Marvel universe enter the picture, White Vision becomes caught in a dangerous journey involving artificial intelligence, advanced technology, and the secrets surrounding his creation. His search for identity forces him to confront the difference between having someone’s memories and actually being that person.

As the Marvel story continues beyond WandaVision, White Vision must discover whether he is simply a machine carrying another man’s memories or a new individual capable of creating his own future. His journey could change everything we understand about the Vision and the future of the MCU.
